facts.fact: Four 删完模拟数据后没动，判断 Caleb 的活是掩盖这次袭击模拟，那样就不能留下证人
facts.anchor: if his job is to cover up the attack simulation, he can’t leave a witness

facts.fact: Four 认定 Jeanine Matthews 会讲故事，今天的事她已经备好一套叙事
Four 轻声开口，替 Caleb 把结论说出来——你得杀我，对吧
facts.anchor: going to have to kill me, aren’t you

facts.fact: Caleb 答自己不认识 Four，但了解自己的父亲
对面的 Tris 跪倒在地、蜷成一团，Four 一度担心自己对她的信心放错了地方
facts.anchor: Tris falls to her knees, curled up into a tight ball

facts.fact: 随后 Tris 的身体像花一样舒展开，模拟过去了
facts.anchor: her body unfurls like a flower, blooming

facts.fact: Tris 举枪对准 Caleb，Four 起身想闪开，被 Caleb 抓住夹克后襟拽到身前
facts.anchor: He grabs me by the back of my jacket and wrenches me

facts.fact: 结尾 Four 说了两遍没事，然后等她放下枪
facts.anchor: And I wait for her to put down her gun
